name: SignOff Semiconductors
capabilities: Full Custom Analog and Digital Custom Layout and Verification
india_angle: SignOff Semiconductors has offices in Bengaluru and Hyderabad, indicating a strong presence in India.
summary: SignOff Semiconductors is a consulting company specializing in design services for the semiconductor industry. They offer expertise in physical design, custom layout, and RTL design and verification, helping clients meet aggressive schedules and maintain competitiveness. With offices in India, Canada, and the US, they are well-positioned to serve a global client base.
